amendmentA4.governingNodeRule: issuerNodeId for operating-company and fund; node.id for contract
amendmentA4.renamedTest: a room document addressed under a node other than the room's governing node FAILS
amendmentA4.renamedTestValidatesAgainst: the governing node, and it now also fails a document addressed under the twin's own security node
positiveTests: an operating-company twin's room documents are addressed under issuerNodeId
a contract-shape twin's room documents are addressed under node.id
amendmentA4.newRefinement: a contract-shape twin carrying an issuerNodeId FAILS: a futures contract has no issuer
amendmentA4.additionalRefinement: an issuer-bearing shape missing issuerNodeId FAILS: its room would have no governing node

provenanceClasses.enforcement: layerOf() pins the class as a literal on all four status branches; class-specific provenance schemas make the fields required (Record: authority + upstreamRef; Observation: measurement; Derivation: formula + inputs; Synthesis: non-empty citations)
provenanceClasses.notDeclared: Attention and Judgment carry no layer at v0.1, so their field requirements are deliberately undeclared, per the governing principle that nothing unbuilt is stubbed

remaining: The human door does not render room.authorityDeterminations, so the /GC not-applicable determination for issuer disclosure is in the payload but invisible in apps/web. The agent door returns it. Small InstrumentView addition, left out to keep this change set to the amendment.
Both upstream adapters remain unwired route skeletons returning typed lookup-failed absences. Real twins wait on TW-24, which this work does not change.
market.computed and the fund-shape roster remain absent from the schema by version scope, which is the design and not a gap.

The ULID regex is strict: 26 uppercase Crockford base32 characters after the sec_, iss_, or opt_ prefix. If the live security-master mints another form, resolution fails loudly at the boundary rather than silently. Intended, but it is the first thing to check when the cockpit resolver is wired.
